title: Image
description: Image display UI element for rendering sprites and textures.
content:
Image

Image display UI element for rendering sprites, textures, and icons in the interface.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"image": {
  "sprite": "...",
  "scale": 0.0
}

Description

The Image component displays static images and sprites in the UI. It renders textures, icons, and other visual assets as part of the user interface layout. The component supports sprite references from asset packs and configurable scaling for flexible display sizing.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
spritestringThe sprite or texture asset ID to display.
scalefloatScale multiplier for the displayed image (1.0 = original size).

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "image": {
      "sprite": "ui_logo",
      "scale": 2.0
    }
  }
}
